role: Compute stable PhraseNode IDs from text via normalized hashing
detail: Single utility module exporting phrase_node_id(text: str) -> str, which computes a deterministic node identifier by normalizing input (lowercase + collapse whitespace) and hashing with SHA256. Returns format phrase:{sha256_12} (12-char hex prefix of full SHA256 digest). Used for consistent PhraseNode ID generation across the perception service. No side effects (pure function). Intentionally minimal scope: only normalization and hashing logic, no database or network I/O.
gotchas: Hash prefix truncated to 12 chars; collision risk minimal but nonzero at scale. No input validation (accepts any string). Whitespace normalization uses split() which collapses all consecutive whitespace to single space.
